parameters.content:
## Slack AI → TurboQuote (CPQ) and E-Signature

### How it works

This workflow turns a Slack quote request into a TurboQuote draft using AI-assisted product selection and catalog pricing. It loads pricing data, asks an AI agent to structure line items, validates that there is something to quote, then looks up the customer and creates a draft quote with line items. It posts either a review link back to Slack or a Slack notification when no quoteable items or customer match is found.

### Setup steps

- Connect Slack credentials for the trigger and posting nodes, and configure the quote-request channel or event the workflow should listen to.
- Connect TurboDocx/TurboQuote credentials for catalog lookup, customer/company search, contact retrieval, quote creation, and line-item creation.
- Connect OpenAI credentials for the AI Agent chat model, and ensure the structured output parser schema matches the expected quote line-item format.
- Review the "Set quote defaults" node values such as appBaseUrl, currency, termDays, and validDays.
- Verify that TurboQuote catalog products, customer companies, primary contacts, and quote templates or draft quote settings are available and named consistently with expected Slack requests.

### Customization

Adjust the AI prompt/schema to capture different product attributes, change the default quote terms and validity period, or customize the Slack messages for review links and exception paths.

## Receive quote request

Starts the workflow from a Slack quote request and initializes default quote settings such as base URL, currency, payment term, and validity period.

## Load pricing catalog

Retrieves the TurboQuote product catalog and aggregates it into a usable pricing dataset for downstream AI and pricing steps.

## Draft quote with AI

Uses an OpenAI-powered agent, catalog search tool, and structured line-item schema to interpret the Slack request and produce a draft list of quote line items.

## Validate priced items

Matches AI-selected products back to the real catalog to attach list prices, then branches based on whether any valid quoteable items remain.

## Handle empty quote

Posts a Slack notification when the AI and catalog matching steps do not produce anything that can be quoted.

## Find customer record

Searches for the customer company in TurboQuote and branches depending on whether a matching company is found, including the nearby Slack error response for missing customers.

## Create draft quote

Retrieves the company’s primary contact and creates the initial draft quote record in TurboQuote.

## Post quote review

Adds the selected line items to the draft quote, limits the result to a single Slack post, and sends the quote review link back to Slack.

parameters.text:
=A sales rep wrote this in Slack:
"""
{{ $('When Quote Request Received').item.json.text }}
"""

Work out (1) the customer / company name and (2) each product they want with its quantity.
For EACH distinct product, call the "Search TurboQuote catalog" tool with a SHORT root keyword: singular, no adjectives or quantities (search "server", not "2 new servers"; "monitor", not "large monitors"). If a search returns nothing, try a shorter or alternate keyword before giving up. Take the productId from the tool result. Only use productIds the tool returned; if a product truly isn't in the catalog, leave it out. Never output prices.

options.systemMessage: You are a sales quoting assistant. You map a plain-English product request to catalog SKUs by searching the catalog once per product with a short singular keyword. You never invent products, IDs, or prices — only use what the catalog search tool returns.

filters.query: ={{ $fromAI('search', 'A product name or SKU to search the catalog for', 'string') }}
